themes.title: AI-found PHP flaws trigger global patch race
themes.summary: Researchers using OpenAI and Google models uncovered two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) in PHP, the language behind a majority of the world's websites. Officials say the bugs are already being broadly exploited, forcing platforms from Amazon to Google Cloud into an urgent coordinated patch effort.
themes.angle: First mass-market proof that AI can find internet-scale flaws faster than humans can patch them

themes.title: Gulf AI infrastructure and adoption build-out
themes.summary: Saudi Arabia's compute build-out advanced as HUMAIN, DataVolt and Nebius signed a framework for 50MW of AI data-centre capacity at NEOM's Oxagon. The UAE pushed adoption on multiple fronts: an AI-powered tourist VAT refund platform, AI services in ADGM courts, a global push to turn AI agents into products, and CNTXT AI's $60M raise. Saudi also climbed global AI-skills rankings as workers upskill.
themes.angle: GCC is moving from AI ambition to contracted megawatts and deployed services

themes.title: Agentic AI becomes a weapon in the cyber arms race
themes.summary: Microsoft warns of Chinese state-linked attacks powered by AI agents, while separate reporting shows hackers using Claude and Grok to automate bank attacks. New research finds frontier models can now blueprint attacks on power and water systems, yet the models defenders rely on sometimes refuse to help investigate.
themes.angle: Offensive agentic AI is now a board-level threat; defensive tooling must keep pace

themes.title: Meta lifts AI capex and invents a war-chest share class
themes.summary: Meta raised its 2026 capital-expenditure outlook to $135-145 billion and created a new class of non-voting stock to fund AI spending without diluting founder control, including a deal to keep Zuckerberg in California in the face of a wealth-tax proposal.

themes.title: OpenAI's enterprise distribution push goes multi-cloud
themes.summary: OpenAI is bringing its frontier models and Codex coding tools to Google Cloud's Model Garden, making it available on all three major US clouds. It also published enterprise deployments at AT&T legal and Cloudflare, and expanded ChatGPT Ads to 26 new countries with over 100,000 advertisers.
themes.angle: Model labs now compete on distribution and enterprise workflows, not just benchmarks

themes.title: UAE-Singapore CEPA deepens AI and energy ties
themes.summary: Singapore's Prime Minister visited Abu Dhabi as the two countries launched CEPA negotiations and explored cooperation on AI, advanced technology and energy. A high-level business dialogue in Abu Dhabi set out joint workstreams under the UAE-Singapore Comprehensive Partnership.
themes.angle: The UAE is wiring up a Singaporean bridge for AI, capital and talent

themes.title: Anthropic ships the Claude 5.5 generation
themes.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5: Opus 5.5 leads in agentic coding and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5, Sonnet runs 30% faster at up to 30% lower cost, and Haiku targets high-volume agentic work. Anthropic also opened a Singapore office and signed an MOU with its government.
themes.angle: The cost-per-agent curve keeps bending; smaller models are the enterprise workhorses

themes.title: Musk's Tesla-SpaceX merger talk
themes.summary: Elon Musk is exploring merging Tesla and SpaceX in what the FT frames as a $3.6tn bet, as Tesla reports flat revenue and pivots from electric vehicles to AI. Analysts debate shareholder dilution and regulatory hurdles, with Space Ventures investor Steve Westly predicting the combination.
themes.angle: The biggest corporate roll-up of the AI era is being floated in plain sight
